After Nxf1 Qxf1+, White can play Rxf1 and again wins the queen. But Rxf1 is cleaner because it immediately pins the queen to the back rank and keeps the rook attacking it while capturing.

The best move is **Rxf1**, winning material by force through a knight fork motif.

**Best move:** Rxf1

**Main line:** Rxf1 Qxf1+ Nxf1

**Motif:** fork (the knight forks the queen and rook, winning both), attraction (forcing the queen to f1)

**Coaching note:**
After Black plays Rxf1+ checking your king, look for forcing captures. Rxf1 wins because Black's queen must recapture (Qxf1+), then your knight recaptures with check threats and forks both pieces. Always scan for discovered attacks and rook+knight tactics when capturing near the enemy king—they create winning forks.
